subject: IRC Jordan - Livelihoods Programme
name: International Rescue Committee (IRC) - Jordan
body:
Dear IRC Jordan team,

Your Jordan page highlights Hamida, a Syrian refugee and photographer, and a beekeeper, demonstrating resilience through skills and daily work.

I am Ahmad Haddad, a director and cinematographer based in Jordan; my experience includes similar projects for USAID and QRTA. A short documentary following one participant’s day within an active livelihoods programme could combine her account with a programme officer's explanation of verified outcomes.

This would deliver a donor-facing film, subtitled social cutdowns, and a small portrait series, subject to consent and programme access.

I'd be glad to discuss the possibility whenever time allows.

Ahmad Haddad

body:

Your team’s priorities connect access to quality education with helping young people gain the skills and knowledge they need to get good jobs.

I'd be glad to discuss the possibility whenever time allows.

name: WUSC Jordan Country Office
body:
Dear WUSC Jordan Country Office team,

Oraib Sakkijha

WUSC Jordan runs programs that support both refugee and host community youth in accessing education and livelihood opportunities.

I'm Ahmad Haddad, a director and cinematographer; much of my work is short documentaries for organisations working in the community.

We could film a short documentary following a young Jordanian woman in a WUSC-supported skills training program as she launches a small business, showing her daily challenges and hopes for the future.

Happy to explain the idea further whenever suits you. And if it doesn't fit your plans, no worries at all; all the best with your work.

Ahmad Haddad
Director & Cinematographer, FAII HOUSE

name: UNDP RBAS Regional Hub
body:
Dear UNDP RBAS Regional Hub team,

UNDP RBAS supports youth-led climate resilience projects across Arab States, including in Jordan.

I'm Ahmad Haddad, a director and cinematographer in Jordan; for years I've worked with organisations on films that show their impact through people. I film organisational impact through people.

We could film a short documentary following a youth-led climate adaptation project in a Jordanian village supported by UNDP RBAS, showing how local innovation meets regional challenges through training, community action, and sustainable solutions.

The idea is yours to shape; I'm happy to hear what you think. If it isn't something you need right now, I completely understand.

Ahmad Haddad
Director & Cinematographer, FAII HOUSE
